content_blocks.text: The morning sun filtered through the fog, casting an eerie glow over the abandoned lighthouse. The old keeper, a weathered man named Thomas, stood at the edge of the cliff, his eyes scanning the horizon. His hands trembled slightly as he adjusted the lens of his telescope, searching for any sign of movement. It had been years since he last saw a ship in these parts, yet today felt different. A sense of unease settled in his chest, a whisper in the fog that refused to be silenced.
